answer: Every claim climbs the horizon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ember re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the dune is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
